visual.general_description: Two contrast-enhanced chest CT images (axial and coronal) of the heart region, with no printed panel letters.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale contrast-enhanced chest CT image on a black background, made of two side-by-side images with no printed panel letters. The left image is a transverse (axial) slice through the lower chest: the lungs are dark, the ribs and chest wall form a ring, and the heart sits anteriorly with a brightly opacified region on the viewer-left side and a large grey, less dense region on the viewer-right side with a brighter curved band along its lower edge. A round structure and the vertebral body lie posteriorly. The right image is a coronal slice showing the mediastinum and heart between the dark lungs, with a brightly opacified structure in the centre-left of the heart region, a grey oval region to its lower right and the liver and upper abdomen below. Small overlay text in the upper corners of the coronal image is only partly legible: an ID-like numeric string at the upper left and header text at the upper right; it is not transcribed. No arrows, labels, scale bars or measurements are visible.
